topic: Hackathons and builder programs for the Stacks inscription protocol, app, and platform
objective: Find current or upcoming hackathons, grants, accelerators, bounties, demo days, and builder programs where a Stacks-based inscription protocol, app, or platform would be a strong fit. Prioritize anything that could benefit from cheap, fast, composable, immutable, on-chain data inscriptions across areas like AI messaging systems, truly on-chain web3 apps, developer infrastructure, creator tools, identity, permanent media, and application backends.
reportInstructions: Prioritize current or upcoming opportunities, note likely fit for protocol vs app vs platform submissions, and end with a short operator-facing recommendation on the strongest entries to pursue first.

sources.label: X hackathon chatter
sources.query: hackathon OR bounty OR accelerator OR grant (Stacks OR Bitcoin OR "on-chain data" OR Web3 OR AI) -filter:retweets lang:en

sources.label: X on-chain app and AI builder chatter
sources.query: "on-chain app" OR "onchain app" OR "AI agent" OR "AI messaging" OR composable immutable data (hackathon OR builders OR demo day OR accelerator) -filter:retweets lang:en

sources.label: Web search for relevant hackathons
sources.query: Find current or upcoming hackathons, grants, accelerators, and builder programs relevant to Bitcoin, Stacks, web3 infrastructure, AI x crypto, messaging protocols, on-chain apps, permanent data, and composable app backends.
